name: Reports Center
route: No live route; reports are an export module opened from Me, Intelligence, Help, and CIA contexts.
annotation: HIFI-78 · no live route · dark warm shell w/ top radial orange · one Newsreader italic on 'CIA' in the hero H1.

modules.build: iOS status bar, time 9:41 left, battery/wifi right, white text on dark bg.
Sticky header, transparent/glass bg. Left: back chevron + 'Reports' title (white). White 8% 1px bottom border on scroll. No right-side glyph — spec's ASCII shows title only.

Glass card (white 4.5% fill, border white 8%, r40, purple #7F24FF glow top-center). Overline 11 uppercase white 60% 'REPORT BUILDER'. H1 30 white 'Build reports *CIA* helps you understand.' (CIA italic). Body 15 white 70% 'Review your data with CIA, choose what to share.' Row of 3 GhostPills (r16, 44px target): 'CIA summary', 'Private by default', 'Ready'.

SectionHeader 'RECENT REPORTS' (overline) + BtnGhost 'New' (orange #FF5E00 text, 44px target). Two GlassCard rows (r24, white 8% border): 'Weekly life report' / Caption green 'status: Ready' / ProgressRing 40x40 86% green / '6 of 7 synced'. 'Doctor summary' / Caption orange 'status: Draft' / ProgressRing 40x40 43% orange / '3 of 7 synced'.

SectionHeader 'THIS WEEK' (overline). 2-col BentoGrid gap 12: left tile (r24, solid #211008) 'sleep 82%' H3 white + ChipProvenance 'via wearable'; right tile 'work 64%' H3 white + ChipProvenance 'you logged'. Below, CIAInsightCard (glass, r24, purple #7F24FF glow left): CIA icon + Body 15 white 'CIA: Sleep firmed up most this week.'
Fixed footer row, right-aligned, gap 12px, pinned above home indicator. BtnPrimary 54h 'Share' (orange #FF5E00) — sole BtnPrimary on screen. BtnGhost text 'Screenshot guide' (white 70%).
Dark base #0A0A0F with standard iOS home indicator bar (white 30%).

belowFold.build: Preview Sheet state, stacked-card transition, solid bg #211008. TrendChart (solid line = real, dashed 'estimated · low confidence' = projection), KPIRow settling counts, ProgressRing sweep, correlation rows ('early signal' low-confidence, ghost cells 'Correlations appear after 1-2 weeks' honest-null). Privacy line: 'Private notes, raw journal entries, and hidden photos are excluded by default.'

Consent sheet reachable from Preview before Share, with ChipProvenance source labels: 'category', 'source', 'scope', 'freshness', 'retention', 'export', 'revoke', 'delete'. Satisfies per-field consent/export/revoke/delete requirement.

trustControls: Private notes, raw journal entries, and hidden photos are excluded by default and named in the review block.
Reports Center uses source chips for category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete where data appears.
This is documented as a modal, overlay, utility, or source-only surface; do not invent a live route.
notes: Italic word resolved to 'CIA' (literal hero H1: 'Build reports *CIA* helps you understand.') over the Visual System's generic '*center*' placeholder, which never appears as literal rendered copy — same resolution pattern used on 79-call-summary ('recovery' over '*summary*') and 03c-consent ('begin' over '*consent*'). CIAInsightCard's spec-marked '*week*' is de-italicized in build (rendered plain) to hold canon's one-italic-word-per-screen rule.

Modules consolidated to 7 (≤8 cap): 'Recent Reports' merges the SectionHeader with both ReportCards; 'This Week' merges its SectionHeader with the BentoGrid and CIAInsightCard. Status Bar and Home Indicator kept as explicit modules per canon ('status bar + home indicator on every screen').
'New' corrected from a primary button to BtnGhost (orange text, 44px target) — canon allows only one BtnPrimary per screen, held here by the footer 'Share' button.
ChipProvenance chips ('via wearable', 'you logged') rendered neutral, not orange-tinted — orange is reserved for member-effort/CTA semantics, not provenance labeling.

TopBar kept minimal (back chevron + 'Reports' title only), matching the spec's literal ASCII. The Focal Hierarchy's 'TopBar with CIA' line is boilerplate reviewer phrasing repeated across many screens' specs, not a literal instruction — no CIA glyph appears in this screen's Final Composition.
ProgressRings on Recent Reports represent report sync completeness (6 of 7 / 3 of 7 days synced) per Data Honesty, not fake streaks or arbitrary progress.
Preview Sheet (ModalOverlay) and TrustControlsSheet held in belowFold as alternate states/sheets, not scroll overflow — default flow fits 0–844 exactly with no overflow.
